subject: APAC market entry: GPU supply cadence & pilot sizing
messages:
From: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@orionai.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orionai.com
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00+08:00
Subject: Pilot timing & APAC dedicated pool ask

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Orion is preparing a pilot for APAC customers (Singapore + Sydney) and we need to lock a small dedicated pool for low-latency inference during the 90-day pilot. Key asks:

- Pilot start window: target week of 2026-08-10
- Expected peak concurrency: ~45 sustained QPS (chat-style requests, median seq len ~512 tokens)
- Model: preference for a 70B LLM (we'll evaluate both q4_0 and q8_0 variants)
- SLA: 200ms p95 token latency target for synchronous calls; fallback to lower-priority queued compute acceptable for overflow

Can Redwood confirm suggested initial GPU sizing, what you can guarantee in APAC, and any lead times for reserved capacity? We also need an indicative monthly commitment for procurement. Attaching the high-level pilot scope and latency profile.

Sophie Chan
Head of Product
Orion AI

Attachments: pilot_scope_apac.pdf (attached), latency_profile_promptset.csv (attached)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@orionai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T10:05:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timing & APAC dedicated pool ask

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the details and timeline. Short answer: yes, we can provision an APAC-dedicated pool for a pilot, but sizing and latency guarantees depend on model variant and quantization. Quick next steps:

1) I can schedule a 30-min sizing triage with our infra team this week to confirm model variant/seq length assumptions.
2) I'll share a conservative starter configuration and two expansion paths (cost/latency trade-offs).
3) We will confirm lead time for reserved nodes — typically 3–5 weeks in APAC for H100-backed capacity; A100 fallbacks can be faster in some clouds.

Suggested starter (conservative):
- Equivalent of 3 H100-class machines dedicated (continuous burst-capable pool).
- Expected steady-state token throughput to meet ~45 QPS for 512 tokens with batching tuned: estimated p95 generation latency ~180–260ms depending on q/ops.

I looped in Marcus and Lauren for commercial sizing and commitment discussion. Marcus — can you run the model-profile against our APAC capacity model and return a quick sizing + MRC estimate?

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (I will attach a baseline capacity worksheet after the triage)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T14:32:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timing & APAC dedicated pool ask

Folks — quick model-backed notes after running the numbers against Orion's profile (45 QPS, median 512 tokens). Assumptions: 70B decoder-only model, beam=1, streaming enabled, KV cache warm on session affinity, batching window ~12ms. Results:

Starter (pilot) config — conservative:
- 3 H100-equivalent instances (per our internal perf table this maps to ~2 H100 80GB or 3 A100 80GB equivalent across clouds)
- Estimated sustained QPS capacity: 50–60 with careful batching and prefix caching
- p95 latency: 160–220ms (q8_0) / 200–320ms (q4_0) — q8_0 preferable for latency-sensitive chat
- Monthly reserved cost (indicative MRC): USD 52,000–68,000 depending on cloud provider and spot/blended pricing assumptions

Expansion path if pilot converts (scale to production):
- Stage 1 (convert): add 6 more H100-equivalents -> 9 total for regional redundancy and headroom (target EOY scale)
- Stage 2 (enterprise): 12–16 H100 equivalents with cross-region failover and dedicated ingress in SYD+SIN

Risks / operational notes:
- H100 availability in APAC is constrained; lead time ~3–6 weeks for firm reservations.
- If Orion requires hard 200ms p95 for all traffic and heavier prompt sets, we should consider 9 H100-equivalents from day-1 or a hybrid H100+A10G approach for non-critical workloads.

I'll attach a compact capacity model (xlsx) with the numbers and a cost sensitivity tab.

-Marcus
Principal Infra Planner | Redwood Inference

Attachments: apac_capacity_model_v3.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, avery_johnson@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timing & APAC dedicated pool ask

Adding a few commercial and deployment constraints to consider before we commit to a specific MRC:

- Commitment term: Procurement teams often want a 12-month reserved clause; we can design a 3-month pilot discount that converts to a 12-month commitment on signed purchase order. Need legal to approve pilot-to-reserved handover language.
- Burst policy: propose we include a burst pool (shared capacity with soft throttles) for occasional spikes — this lowers Orion's initial MRC while protecting p95 for primary traffic.
- SLA exception: offer a pilot SLA that is best-effort for latency with a clear escalation path; reserve strict p95 SLA for post-conversion.
- Marketplace & procurement: Andrew Liu from CloudZone can accelerate instance reservations if Orion is open to a cloud marketplace transaction (reduces lead time).

Action: Lauren — do you want me to prepare two commercial skus (pilot: 90 days, refundable credits; production: 12-month reserved)? I can attach redline language for the pilot conversion clause.

-Karthik
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@orionai.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:41:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timing & APAC dedicated pool ask

Sophie & team —

Thanks — this looks workable. High-level commercial proposal we can put in writing today:

- Pilot package (90 days): 3 H100-equivalents reserved for the pilot window, pilot discount applied (25% off list MRC), include 50% burst credits to be used for overflow. Pilot converts to a 12-month reserved contract unless Orion provides 30-day written opt-out.
- Conversion pricing: scale pricing tiers (9 units and 16 units) with step-down unit pricing at each tier.
- Procurement docs: we will issue a Statement of Work (SOW_OrionAI_APAC_v2.pdf) and a draft pilot addendum.

Next steps: Avery / Marcus — finalize the capacity sheet and exact MRC ranges. Karthik — please draft the pilot addendum and conversion clause; loop legal if you hit any unusual terms. Sophie — if Orion is happy, we can provision a soft-reservation (non-billable hold) with CloudZone to guarantee lead time.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, APAC | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_OrionAI_APAC_v2.pdf (for review)

From: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@orionai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orionai.com, andrew@cloudzone.com
Date: 2026-07-03T16:34:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timing & APAC dedicated pool ask

Lauren / Avery —

This all sounds reasonable and faster than we expected. Procurement will review the SOW and pilot terms; they asked Andrew to confirm marketplace reservation path. For timing, we accept the 3–5 week lead window — please put the soft-reservation in place and share the capacity workbook and draft addendum.

Two quick clarifications before we lock:
- Can Redwood guarantee cross-AZ redundancy inside Singapore region? We want single-region geo with AZ redundancy, not multi-region for the pilot.
- If we hit sustained 2x the expected QPS during the pilot, how will overage billing or throttling be handled?

I'll have procurement get back to you with a PO template by EOD Friday. Thanks all.

Sophie Chan
Head of Product
Orion AI
